thread:
Sam - Acme: Hey team, hitting 400s from the rerank endpoint after our deploy. Example response below. Can share request id if needed.

Sam - Acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "query": "find best reply",
    "candidates": {"id": 1, "text": "candidate"}
  }'

Sam - Acme: Response: HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "invalid_request",
  "message": "schema validation failed: candidates: expected array, got object"
}

Maya (Support): Thanks Sam — can you paste the X-Request-ID header (or the timeframe)? quick check: is the client serializing the candidates as an object instead of an array?

Sam - Acme: X-Request-ID: req_20231122_abc123. Hitting it consistently for several requests since the 11/22 deploy. We ship JS client that constructs payloads; will grab the snippet.

Maya (Support): Repro attempt from my side with the same body. I ran the exact curl you posted and got the same 400. Pasting request/response from our ingress logs for the request id you provided:

CI Bot: [ingress] req_20231122_abc123 POST /v1/rerank 400 
Error: validation failed - candidates must be array

Maya (Support): @Devon can you take a look? appears to be a client-side shape issue but want to confirm if we should return a clearer error or accept forgiving types.

Devon (Eng): Jumping in. From the parsing logs it looks like the client is sending a single object in candidates (maybe they forget square brackets) and sometimes stringifying the inner objects. Two common failure modes we see:
- candidates as an object instead of array: { "id": 1, "text": "..." }
- candidates as a string: "[{\"id\":\"1\",\"text\":\"a\"}]" (double-encoded)

Devon (Eng): Quick repro I ran that fails: 

```
# fails - object instead of array
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "query": "foo",
    "candidates": {"id": 1, "text": "candidate A"}
  }'
```

Devon (Eng): Correct payload should be:

```
# correct
{
  "query": "foo",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "1", "text": "candidate A"},
    {"id": "2", "text": "candidate B"}
  ]
}
```

Devon (Eng): Note: our schema expects candidate.id to be a string. We currently reject numbers to keep IDs stable across embeddings/rerank joins. We could coerce ints to strings, but that has downstream implications for join keys in analytics.

Maya (Support): Temporary mitigation for Sam: update your client to ensure candidates is an array and id is a string. Eg: 

```
// JS example
const payload = {
  query: userQuery,
  candidates: candidatesList.map(c => ({ id: String(c.id), text: c.text }))
}
```

Maya (Support): We'll add a clearer error message from the API (right now the validation bubble is "candidates: expected array").@Devon any ETA on change?

Devon (Eng): I opened a small patch to do two things: 1) improve validation error text to include the offending field path and received type, 2) add optional lenient coercion behind a feature flag for internal testing. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rerank/PR-4321 (internal). Planning to ship the validation-only change in the next minor (hotfix) tomorrow if tests pass. Coercion will need product approval.

Sam - Acme: Thanks — we'll patch the client today. Two questions: can Redwood accept numeric ids for the short term? Also, can you confirm this is the reason for all our 400s?

Devon (Eng): For the short term, no public change yet. If you need a workaround we can add a request-level workaround for your org (not ideal). But the root cause for the 400s in the timeframe you reported is the malformed candidates payloads. We matched the timestamps and saw ~120 failing requests from your API key with identical validation errors.

Maya (Support): Action items:
- Sam: roll client patch -> ensure candidates is an array, cast ids to string.
- Devon: ship clearer validation message tomorrow (PR opened).
- Maya: follow up in 24h and confirm error count drops.

Sam - Acme: Patch deployed. I changed the serializer to always emit arrays and string ids. Re-testing now...

Sam - Acme: Verified — rerank requests now return 200 and expected scores. Huge thanks.

Maya (Support): Great news :tada: Closing this thread. I'll keep the ticket open until we push the validation message change.

Devon (Eng): Follow-up note: we'll log an analytics event when we coerce or reject candidate id types so we can monitor any remaining clients sending bad payloads.

Maya (Support): Closing summary: cause = malformed request JSON (candidates field wrong type / number ids), fix = client serialization change + validation message update (internal PR linked). If Sam or others hit similar, re-open or ping #eng-oncall.
